title: Commerce Shipping Zone
description: One shipping zone: where it covers and what it costs
formgrid:
label label
countries regions
rate freeOver

label.label: Label
label.help: What the buyer sees at checkout.

countries.label: Countries
countries.help: The countries in this zone. Leave empty for a zone that covers every country, such as a last zone for the rest of the world.

regions.label: Regions
regions.help: Optional. States or provinces, to limit the zone to part of its countries, such as CA and OR. Leave empty for the whole of each country.

rate.label: Rate
rate.help: The shipping charge in the store's currency, such as 12.00.

freeOver.label: Free Over
freeOver.help: Orders at or over this amount ship free in this zone. Leave empty for never.
